text:
ashley: quick follow-up from the postmortem: the uploader flaps caused a flood of pages. proposing a small, measurable canary for any dedupe & threshold changes so we don't regress. want owners + acceptance criteria here.

ravi: i can own the canary rollout. plan: 10% traffic routing to a tuned alerting config for 48h, compare page rate and TP/FP against control.

zoe: sounds good. what metrics do we use to judge FP vs TP? need a clear eval so we can revert automatically.

michael: metrics: page_count, unique_incident_ids, mean_time_to_ack, and customer_error_rate (5xxs on uploader). We'll capture baseline for 24h before starting.

jenny: for FP detection i'd add correlation with deploys and traffic spikes. if page_count rises but customer_error_rate doesn't, treat as FP. Also suggest we track per-region deltas.

ravi: agree. Canary config details:
- dedupe: group_key = job + bucket + region + error_type
- suppression: 20s initial suppression, 8m rolling window
- threshold: median(5m) + p95 smoothing, trigger for 3m sustained
- routing: tag requests header `X-Alert-Config: canary` and route in router.

ashley: include the exact PromQL we will use in the PR. jotting a draft: 
```
# baseline p95 latency on uploader by job
baseline_p95 = histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(uploader_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job, region))
# pages per minute
pages_per_min = increase(alerts_total{alertname="uploader_latency_high"}[15m]) / 15
```
will need grafana panels for these.

zoe: for automatic rollback: revert canary if pages_per_min in canary > control by > 30% AND customer_error_rate change < 5%. also rollback if MTTACK increases > 2x.

michael: agree. add manual override for SRE to keep canary if it's noisy but shows better customer metrics.

jenny: i'll add a short test harness to synth traffic to uploader in staging to validate we've not masked multi-region issues. will run before canary.

ashley: owners & ETAs (please confirm):
- Canary rollout + automation (routing flag + rollback): ravi 1 ETA Tue EOD
- PromQL & grafana panels: michael 1 ETA Mon noon
- Staging synthetic test harness: jenny 1 ETA Mon EOD
- Runbook updates + acceptance criteria doc: zoe 1 ETA Tue morning

ravi: confirmed. will open a PR with automation playbook.

michael: confirmed. will attach panels and a dashboard link.

jenny: confirmed. staging runbook will include test results.

oncall-bot: Calendar event created: "Alert tuning canary sync" Tue 15:00 UTC 1 attendees: #eng-oncall. Reminder 15m prior.

ashley: thanks. please paste PR links and dashboard snapshots here. we'll only merge after both staging tests pass and the runbook is updated. :thumbsup:
